mirror_diameter
label: Mirror diameter
description: The clear diameter of your primary mirror.

name: focal_ratio
label: Focal ratio (f/number)
description: Focal length divided by diameter. Fast mirrors make a short tube; the highest ratio the form allows keeps the eyepiece below your eye height.

name: mirror_thickness
label: Mirror thickness at the edge
description: Measure it, or take diameter / 6 to diameter / 8 for a full-thickness mirror. Sets the mass, the balance and how many support points the cell needs (3 or 9; a mirror thinner than diameter / 18 needs a professional cell and is refused).

name: illuminated_field
label: Fully illuminated field (focal plane)
description: Field that gets all the mirror's light, at the focal plane. 12.7 mm is general use; more for low power, less for planets. Drives the size of the secondary.

name: tube_type
label: Tube
description: The tube material: a paper form tube comes in 2-inch steps of inside diameter (measure your wall and pick the nearest), a rolled tube is made to measure.

name: focuser_choice
label: Focuser
description: Its racked-in height, travel and mass enter the optics, the focus check and the balance.

name: eyepiece_choice
label: Balance eyepiece (the one you use most)
description: Its mass is what the balance point is figured for. A heavy eyepiece moves the altitude axis up the tube; the output says how much lighter or heavier the friction still holds. The focuser limits the list: 2-inch barrels need a 2-inch focuser, and the low-profile one lacks the travel for the deepest-focusing eyepiece.

name: spider_vanes
label: Spider vanes
description: Three or four thin vanes hold the secondary. Four vanes give four diffraction spikes, three give six.

name: finder_choice
label: Finder
description: None, a red-dot reflex finder or a straight optical finder. Its mass counts in the balance.

name: board_thickness
label: Plywood thickness
description: Birch plywood for the rocker box, ground board and altitude bearings.

name: eye_height_limit
label: Highest comfortable eyepiece height
description: How high your eye can reach at the eyepiece, standing or on a stool. Limits the focal ratio.

name: altitude
label: Point the telescope: altitude
description: From 0 degrees (the horizon) to 90 (the zenith). The tube turns on its bearings.

title: Dobsonian telescope
author: 3DCraft Jigs
description: A Newtonian on a plywood rocker box, from your mirror. Give the mirror's diameter, focal ratio and thickness and the field that must be fully lit; the tube, the secondary, the spider, the focuser position, the altitude bearings and the rocker box follow, and the altitude axis sits on the balance point computed from the masses, then measured on the model. Export: Export: File, Export, Sheet of set: Cut sheet as DXF or SVG gives the twelve plywood parts at true size, plus the three 5 mm aluminium whiffle plates on their own layer when the cell needs them; cut.export and cut.list with those bodies give kerf compensation and the saw list.
